scope: Generic flat-load encoding repair; host, BPF compilation and actual failure attribution

actual_failure.cause: Scalar-tagged raw context chose computed address plus zero-offset asm load; stock verifier rejects modified ctx+80

change: Flat reads choose fixed-displacement encoding independently of semantic tag; dynamic and large displacements keep equivalent computed-address encoding. Pointer-valued 64-bit read routes share the selection.

displacement_cases: flat scalar-tagged context80: MOV_LOAD and READ_MEM_VALUE

before_artifacts: before-scalar/route{0,1}.bpf.o; original ABI-tagged controls in before/
after_artifacts: after-scalar/route{0,1}.bpf.o; five compile/host modes in after-encodings/
